subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Analisar questões socioambientais, políticas e econômicas relativas à dependência do mundo atual em relação aos recursos não renováveis e discutir a necessidade de introdução de alternativas e novas tecnologias energéticas e de materiais, comparando diferentes tipos de motores e processos de produção de novos materiais.

components.description_pt: Analisar consequências socioambientais, políticas e econômicas da dependência de recursos energéticos não renováveis
components.description_en: Analyze socio-environmental, political, and economic consequences of dependence on non-renewable energy resources
components.cc_component_description: Identify economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks associated with energy production or resource extraction

components.description_pt: Comparar diferentes tipos de motores em termos de fonte de energia e impacto ambiental
components.description_en: Compare different types of engines in terms of energy source and environmental impact
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate trade-offs between renewable and nonrenewable energy use in terms of environmental effects

components.description_pt: Avaliar a necessidade de fontes alternativas de energia e novas tecnologias energéticas
components.description_en: Evaluate the need for alternative energy sources and new energy technologies
components.cc_component_description: Explain how new technologies can shift the balance between costs and benefits of energy production

components.description_pt: Comparar processos de produção de materiais avançados e suas implicações para sustentabilidade
components.description_en: Compare processes for producing advanced materials and their implications for sustainability
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate human resource management practices based on their impact on biodiversity and sustainability

cc_matches.description: All forms of energy production and other resource extraction have associated economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks as well as benefits. New technologies and social regulations can change the balance of these factors.
Energy and fuels that humans use are derived from natural sources, and their use affects the environment in multiple ways. Some resources are renewable over time, and others are not.
The sustainability of human societies and the biodiversity that supports them requires responsible management of natural resources.
